    $res = 1;
    $a %= MOD;
    while ($e > 0) {
        if ($e & 1) $res = ($res * $a) % MOD;
        $a = ($a * $a) % MOD;
        $e >>= 1;
    }
    return $res;
}

function mod_inv($a) {
    return mod_pow($a, MOD - 2);

$line = trim(fgets(STDIN));

$exps = [];

$invfact = [1];

    $p = $primes[$idx];
    $e = $exps[$idx];

    $dp = array_fill(0, $e + 1, 0);
    $dp[$e] = 1; // start with exponent e

    // precompute inverse of (j+1) for j=0..e
    $inv = [];
    for ($j = 0; $j <= $e; $j++) {
        $inv[$j] = mod_inv($j + 1);

    for ($step = 0; $step < $k; $step++) {
        $next = array_fill(0, $e + 1, 0);
        for ($j = 0; $j <= $e; $j++) {

            $coef = $dp[$j] * $inv[$j] % MOD;

            // next[i] += coef for i=0..j
            // we do simple loop since e <= ~50
            for ($i = 0; $i <= $j; $i++) {
                $next[$i] += $coef;
                if ($next[$i] >= MOD) $next[$i] -= MOD;

// Expected Value after random divisor process
// Constraints: n <= 1e15, k <= 1e4

const MOD = 1000000007;

// fast power mod
function mod_pow($a, $e) {
    $res = 1;
    $a %= MOD;
    while ($e > 0) {
        if ($e & 1) $res = ($res * $a) % MOD;
        $a = ($a * $a) % MOD;
        $e >>= 1;
    }
    return $res;
}

function mod_inv($a) {
    return mod_pow($a, MOD - 2);
}

// read input
$line = trim(fgets(STDIN));
list($n, $k) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', $line));

// factorize n (n <= 1e15)
$primes = [];
$exps = [];

$nn = $n;
for ($p = 2; (int)$p * $p <= $nn; $p += ($p == 2 ? 1 : 2)) {
    if ($nn % $p == 0) {
        $cnt = 0;
        while ($nn % $p == 0) {
            $nn /= $p;
            $cnt++;
        }
        $primes[] = $p;
        $exps[] = $cnt;
    }
}
if ($nn > 1) {
    $primes[] = $nn;
    $exps[] = 1;
}

$m = count($primes);
if ($m == 0) { // n == 1
    echo "1\n";
    exit;
}

// precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to max exponent
$maxE = max($exps);
$fact = array_fill(0, $maxE + 1, 1);
$ifact = array_fill(0, $maxE + 1, 1);
for ($i = 1; $i <= $maxE; $i++) {
    $fact[$i] = ($fact[$i - 1] * $i) % MOD;
}
$ifact[$maxE] = mod_inv($fact[$maxE]);
for ($i = $maxE; $i > 0; $i--) {
    $ifact[$i - 1] = ($ifact[$i] * $i) % MOD;
}

// function to compute C(n,k) mod
function comb($n, $k, $fact, $ifact) {
    if ($k < 0 || $k > $n) return 0;
    return ($fact[$n] * $ifact[$k] % MOD) * $ifact[$n - $k] % MOD;
}

// For each prime factor, compute expected value of p^{e_k} after k steps
$ans = 1;

for ($idx = 0; $idx < $m; $idx++) {
    $p = $primes[$idx];
    $e0 = $exps[$idx];

    // dp[t][j]: probability that exponent = j after t steps
    // store as modular value (since all probabilities are rational with denom power of something)
    $dp = array_fill(0, $e0 + 1, 0);
    $dp[$e0] = 1;

    // Precompute inverse of (i+1) for i up to e0
    $inv = array_fill(0, $e0 + 1, 1);
    for ($i = 1; $i <= $e0 + 1; $i++) {
        $inv[$i] = mod_inv($i);
    }

    for ($step = 0; $step < $k; $step++) {
        $ndp = array_fill(0, $e0 + 1, 0);
        for ($i = 0; $i <= $e0; $i++) {
            if ($dp[$i] == 0) continue;

            // probability 1/(i+1) each
            $coef = $dp[$i] * $inv[$i + 1] % MOD;
            for ($j = 0; $j <= $i; $j++) {

    $pe = 1;
    $exp_val = 0;
    for ($j = 0; $j <= $e0; $j++) {
        $exp_val = ($exp_val + $dp[$j] * $pe) % MOD;
        $pe = ($pe * $p) % MOD;
    }

    $ans = ($ans * $exp_val) % MOD;
}

$k = intval($k_str);

$exps = [];

            $cnt++;
        }
        $primes[] = $p;
        $exps[] = $cnt;
    }

    $exps[] = 1;
}

$ifact = array_fill(0, $maxE + 1, 1);

for ($idx = 0; $idx < $m; $idx++) {
    $e = $exps[$idx];
    $row = [];
    for ($j = 0; $j <= $e; $j++) {

    }

<?php
// Expected Value after k random divisor steps
// Solution based on prime factor independence and DP over exponents.

const MOD = 1000000007;

fscanf(STDIN, "%d %d", $n, $k);

// Fast power mod
function mod_pow($a, $e) {
    $mod = MOD;
    $res = 1;
    $a %= $mod;
    while ($e > 0) {
        if ($e & 1) $res = ($res * $a) % $mod;
        $a = ($a * $a) % $mod;
        $e >>= 1;
    }
    return $res;
}

// Factorize n (n <= 1e15)
$primes = [];
$tmp = $n;
for ($p = 2; (int)$p * $p <= $tmp; $p += ($p == 2 ? 1 : 2)) {
    if ($tmp % $p == 0) {
        $cnt = 0;
        while ($tmp % $p == 0) {
            $tmp /= $p;
            $cnt++;
        }
        $primes[] = [$p, $cnt];
    }
}
if ($tmp > 1) $primes[] = [$tmp, 1];

// Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to k
$fact = array_fill(0, $k + 1, 1);
$ifact = array_fill(0, $k + 1, 1);
for ($i = 1; $i <= $k; $i++) $fact[$i] = ($fact[$i - 1] * $i) % MOD;
$ifact[$k] = mod_pow($fact[$k], MOD - 2);
for ($i = $k; $i > 0; $i--) $ifact[$i - 1] = ($ifact[$i] * $i) % MOD;

// Precompute Stirling numbers of the second kind S(k, j) for j=0..k
// Using recurrence: S(n,k) = S(n-1,k-1) + k*S(n-1,k)
$S = array_fill(0, $k + 1, 0);
$S[0] = 1;
for ($nstep = 1; $nstep <= $k; $nstep++) {
    $prev = $S;
    $S = array_fill(0, $k + 1, 0);
    for ($j = 1; $j <= $nstep; $j++) {
        $S[$j] = ($prev[$j - 1] + $j * $prev[$j]) % MOD;
    }
}

// Precompute inverse powers of integers 1..k+1
$inv = array_fill(0, $k + 2, 0);
for ($i = 1; $i <= $k + 1; $i++) {
    $inv[$i] = mod_pow($i, MOD - 2);
}

// For each prime factor p^e, compute expected value contribution
$answer = 1;

foreach ($primes as $pe) {
    $p = $pe[0];
    $e = $pe[1];

    // Precompute p^i mod MOD
    $powp = array_fill(0, $e + 1, 1);
    for ($i = 1; $i <= $e; $i++) {
        $powp[$i] = ($powp[$i - 1] * ($p % MOD)) % MOD;
    }

    // Precompute f_k(i) for i=0..e using formula:
    // f_k(i) = sum_{j=0..k} S(k,j) * (sum_{t=0..i} t^j) / (i+1)^k
    // sum_{t=0..i} t^j via Faulhaber's formula with Bernoulli numbers:
    // sum_{t=0..i} t^j = 1/(j+1) * sum_{m=0..j} (-1)^m * C(j+1,m) * B_m * i^{j+1-m}
    // But computing Bernoulli numbers is heavy; instead we use DP on exponents directly.

    // We instead do DP on exponents: dp[step][exp]
    // dp[0][i] = 1 if i==e else 0
    // dp[step+1][j] = sum_{i=j..e} dp[step][i] / (i+1)
    // We'll compute only dp[k][i] for i=0..e
    $dp = array_fill(0, $e + 1, 0);
    $dp[$e] = 1;

    for ($step = 0; $step < $k; $step++) {
        $prefix = array_fill(0, $e + 2, 0);
        // prefix sums of dp[i]/(i+1)
        for ($i = 0; $i <= $e; $i++) {
            $val = $dp[$i] * $inv[$i + 1] % MOD;
            $prefix[$i + 1] = ($prefix[$i] + $val) % MOD;
        }
        $ndp = array_fill(0, $e + 1, 0);
        for ($j = 0; $j <= $e; $j++) {
            // sum_{i=j..e} dp[i]/(i+1) = prefix[e+1]-prefix[j]
            $ndp[$j] = ($prefix[$e + 1] - $prefix[$j]) % MOD;
            if ($ndp[$j] < 0) $ndp[$j] += MOD;
        }
        $dp = $ndp;
    }

    // Expected value for this prime factor: sum_i dp[i] * p^i
    $ev = 0;
    for ($i = 0; $i <= $e; $i++) {
        $ev = ($ev + $dp[$i] * $powp[$i]) % MOD;
    }

    $answer = ($answer * $ev) % MOD;
}

echo $answer . PHP_EOL;
?>

<?php
// Expected Value after k random divisor steps
// PHP 8 compatible

const MOD = 1000000007;

fscanf(STDIN, "%d %d", $n, $k);

// fast power mod
function mod_pow($a, $e) {
    $res = 1;
    $a %= MOD;
    while ($e > 0) {
        if ($e & 1) $res = ($res * $a) % MOD;
        $a = ($a * $a) % MOD;
        $e >>= 1;
    }
    return $res;
}

// modular inverse
function mod_inv($a) {
    return mod_pow($a, MOD - 2);
}

// factorize n (n <= 1e15)
function factorize($n) {
    $res = [];
    $x = $n;
    for ($p = 2; (int)$p * $p <= $x; $p += ($p == 2 ? 1 : 2)) {
        if ($x % $p == 0) {
            $cnt = 0;
            while ($x % $p == 0) {
                $x /= $p;
                $cnt++;
            }
            $res[] = [$p, $cnt];
        }
    }
    if ($x > 1) $res[] = [$x, 1];
    return $res;
}

$fac = factorize($n);

// Precompute factorials up to max exponent (<= 50)
$maxE = 0;
foreach ($fac as $f) $maxE = max($maxE, $f[1]);
$maxN = $maxE;
$fact = array_fill(0, $maxN + 1, 1);
$invfact = array_fill(0, $maxN + 1, 1);
for ($i = 1; $i <= $maxN; $i++) $fact[$i] = ($fact[$i - 1] * $i) % MOD;
$invfact[$maxN] = mod_inv($fact[$maxN]);
for ($i = $maxN; $i > 0; $i--) {
    $invfact[$i - 1] = ($invfact[$i] * $i) % MOD;
}

// combination C(n,k)
function comb($n, $k, $fact, $invfact) {
    if ($k < 0 || $k > $n) return 0;
    return ($fact[$n] * $invfact[$k] % MOD) * $invfact[$n - $k] % MOD;
}

// For each prime factor p^e, compute expected value contribution
$answer = 1;

foreach ($fac as $f) {
    $p = $f[0];
    $e = $f[1];

    // dp[t][j]: probability that exponent becomes j after t steps
    // store as modular numbers (probabilities as P * inv(Q))
    $dp = array_fill(0, $k + 1, array_fill(0, $e + 1, 0));
    $dp[0][$e] = 1;

    // Precompute inverse of (i+1) for i=0..e
    $inv = [];
    for ($i = 0; $i <= $e; $i++) $inv[$i] = mod_inv($i + 1);

    for ($t = 0; $t < $k; $t++) {
        for ($i = 0; $i <= $e; $i++) {
            $cur = $dp[$t][$i];
            if ($cur == 0) continue;
            $coef = $cur * $inv[$i] % MOD;
            for ($j = 0; $j <= $i; $j++) {
                $dp[$t + 1][$j] = ($dp[$t + 1][$j] + $coef) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }

    // Expected value of p^{exponent} after k steps:
    // E = sum_j dp[k][j] * p^j
    $pk = 1;
    $sum = 0;
    for ($j = 0; $j <= $e; $j++) {
        if ($j == 0) $pk = 1;
        elseif ($j == 1) $pk = $p % MOD;
        else $pk = ($pk * ($p % MOD)) % MOD;
        $sum = ($sum + $dp[$k][$j] * $pk) % MOD;
    }

    $answer = ($answer * $sum) % MOD;
}

echo $answer . PHP_EOL;
?>

    $dp = array_fill(0, $k + 1, array_fill(0, $e + 1, 0));
    $dp[0][$e] = 1;

    $inv = [];
    for ($i = 0; $i <= $e; $i++) {
        $inv[$i] = mod_inv($i + 1);

    for ($t = 0; $t < $k; $t++) {

    }

    $p_mod = $primes[$idx] % MOD;
    $pow = 1; // p^0
    for ($i = 0; $i <= $e; $i++) {
        $pk = ($pk + $dp[$k][$i] * $pow) % MOD;
        $pow = ($pow * $p_mod) % MOD;
    }
    $ans = ($ans * $pk) % MOD;
}

echo $ans . PHP_EOL;

<?php
// Constants
const MOD = 1000000007;

// Fast exponentiation modulo MOD
function mod_pow($a, $e) {
    $res = 1;
    $a %= MOD;
    while ($e > 0) {
        if ($e & 1) $res = ($res * $a) % MOD;
        $a = ($a * $a) % MOD;
        $e >>= 1;
    }
    return $res;
}

// Modular inverse modulo MOD
function mod_inv($a) {
    return mod_pow($a, MOD - 2);
}

// Read input
list($n_str, $k_str) = array_map('trim', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));
$n = intval($n_str);
$k = intval($k_str);

// Factorize n (n <= 1e15)
$primes = [];
$exps = [];
$tmp = $n;
for ($p = 2; (int)$p * $p <= $tmp; $p += ($p == 2 ? 1 : 2)) {
    if ($tmp % $p == 0) {
        $cnt = 0;
        while ($tmp % $p == 0) {
            $tmp /= $p;
            $cnt++;
        }
        $primes[] = $p;
        $exps[] = $cnt;
    }
}
if ($tmp > 1) {
    $primes[] = $tmp;
    $exps[] = 1;
}

$m = count($primes);
$maxE = max($exps);

// Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to maxE
$fact = array_fill(0, $maxE + 1, 1);
$ifact = array_fill(0, $maxE + 1, 1);
for ($i = 1; $i <= $maxE; $i++) {
    $fact[$i] = ($fact[$i - 1] * $i) % MOD;
}
$ifact[$maxE] = mod_inv($fact[$maxE]);
for ($i = $maxE; $i > 0; $i--) {
    $ifact[$i - 1] = ($ifact[$i] * $i) % MOD;
}

// Precompute binomial coefficients C[e][j]
$C = [];
for ($e = 0; $e <= $maxE; $e++) {
    $C[$e] = [];
    for ($j = 0; $j <= $e; $j++) {
        $C[$e][$j] = ($fact[$e] * $ifact[$j] % MOD) * $ifact[$e - $j] % MOD;
    }
}

// Precompute DP for each exponent e: dp_e[0..e][0..k]
$dp_all = [];
for ($idx = 0; $idx < $m; $idx++) {
    $e = $exps[$idx];
    $dp = array_fill(0, $e + 1, array_fill(0, $k + 1, 0));
    for ($i = 0; $i <= $e; $i++) {
        $dp[$i][0] = ($i == $e) ? 1 : 0;
    }
    for ($step = 1; $step <= $k; $step++) {
        for ($i = 0; $i <= $e; $i++) {
            $sum = 0;
            for ($j = 0; $j <= $i; $j++) {
                $sum += $dp[$j][$step - 1];
                if ($sum >= MOD) $sum -= MOD;
            }
            $dp[$i][$step] = $sum * mod_inv($i + 1) % MOD;
        }
    }
    $dp_all[$idx] = $dp;
}

// Combine expectations
$ans = 1;
for ($idx = 0; $idx < $m; $idx++) {
    $p = $primes[$idx] % MOD;
    $e = $exps[$idx];
    $dp = $dp_all[$idx];
    $sum = 0;
    $p_pow = 1;
    for ($i = 0; $i <= $e; $i++) {
        $coef = $dp[$i][$k];
        if ($coef) {
            $sum = ($sum + $coef * $p_pow) % MOD;
        }
        $p_pow = ($p_pow * $p) % MOD;
    }
    $ans = ($ans * $sum) % MOD;
}

echo $ans . PHP_EOL;
?>
